name: Center International Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Center International Group Co.,Ltd. provides building metal enclosure systems solutions in China. The company engages in building integrated photovoltaic; high-end building metal cladding; and soil and groundwater environmental management businesses. It also offers sound barrier systems that are mainly used in transportation engineering fields, such as railways, highways, and urban rail transit. The company also supplies noise control systems, such as concrete, acrylic glass, and foam metal sound barriers.
